title: Idempotent Load Pattern — Companion Files
description: Runnable idempotent load pieces: a canonical MERGE upsert and a self-contained SQLite demo of the load-ID plus staging plus upsert pattern you can re-run safely.
description_es: Piezas ejecutables de carga idempotente: un upsert MERGE canónico y una demo SQLite autocontenida del patrón load ID + staging + upsert que podés re-ejecutar sin riesgo.
